item.title: Why Trump’s $24.3 billion Saudi F-35 deal is raising concerns in US, Israel
item.description: The proposed $24.3 billion sale of F-35 fighter jets to Saudi Arabia is under careful examination. If approved, this transaction would position Saudi Arabia as the second country in the Middle East to acquire these high-tech military aircraft. However, apprehensions about the impact on regional military dynamics and Israel's strategic advantage loom large. Moreover, the growing relationship between Saudi Arabia and China raises further concerns regarding technology security.
item.dc:creator: ARYAN SINGH

item.title: Pakistan airstrike kills 3 in Afghanistan, Taliban warns of ‘crushing response’
item.description: Pakistan and Afghanistan were involved in their most serious military confrontation in years in February. The latest escalation comes days after the Taliban warned that it would defend Afghan territory against any Pakistani military action. In an interview with Al Arabiya English, Mujahid rejected Pakistan's allegations that militant groups based in Afghanistan recruit, train and launch attacks against Pakistan.
item.dc:creator: RAJEEV SINGH

item.title: Bill Gates ex-wife reveals why she didn’t fund daughter's startup
item.description: Melinda French Gates did not fund her daughter Phoebe's startup venture. She wanted Phoebe to experience the fundraising process independently and learn resilience. This approach mirrors Bill Gates' philosophy on inheritance for their children. Phoebe Gates launched a fashion-tech startup called Phia shopping app. French Gates believes rejection builds courage for female founders.

item.title: Allahabad HC rejects heirs’ land plea after 22 years, says state took possession in 1992
item.description: The Allahabad high court dismissed a family's land restoration plea filed after twenty-two years. The court found the family had not challenged dispossession within a reasonable time. Proceedings under the Urban Land Ceiling Act were completed in 1992. The family failed to prove possession when the Repeal Act came into force. Unexplained delay meant the plea could not be considered by the court.

item.title: Canadian billionaire shares rule that he says will make one a millionaire till retirement
item.description: Kevin O'Leary recommends setting aside fifteen percent of your earnings for retirement, emphasizing that this disciplined investment approach can lead to a millionaire status by the age of sixty-five. This method capitalizes on the power of market growth and compounding returns over many years. Despite this insightful advice, many struggle to save this amount due to ongoing living costs.

item.title: Snake spotted under berth in moving Katihar Express; video goes viral
item.description: A snake sighting inside a Katihar Express sleeper coach startled passengers as the reptile slithered out from beneath a berth, causing chaos in the compartment. The incident, captured on video, quickly gained traction on social media, prompting discussions about the state of cleanliness and upkeep in trains. Reactions ranged from shock to disbelief as the footage spread.
item.dc:creator: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK

item.title: Mumbai student alleges home search after pro-Palestine campaign
item.description: A student claims police searched her home for nine hours without a warrant. She alleges her friends were mistreated and she faced detention. The search reportedly linked to a pro-Palestine kite-flying campaign. Police are conducting an inquiry into the alleged incident. The student's landlord has asked her to vacate her residence.
item.dc:creator: VIVEK NARAYANAN

item.title: How Jordon Hudson became an important part of Bill Belichick’s life
item.description: Bill Belichick rarely discusses his personal life, making his comments about Jordon Hudson particularly notable. During a 2025 interview, he praised Hudson as “terrific” and “very helpful,” explaining that she supported him with business matters and his book while he focused on coaching at North Carolina. His remarks offered a glimpse into their relationship, emphasizing companionship, trust, support, and mutual perspective.
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: Michael Jordan’s high school rejection before becoming an NBA legend
item.description: Michael Jordan’s journey to six NBA championships began with a high school setback when he failed to make the varsity team as a sophomore. Instead of giving up, he used the rejection as motivation to improve. His relentless work ethic propelled him from college basketball to NBA superstardom, where he led the Chicago Bulls to six titles and became one of the greatest players in basketball history.
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: AfD tops another German state poll, Merz’s CDU crashes to historic low
item.description: Germany's AfD party has won the state election in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania, delivering a major blow to Chancellor Merz's Christian Democratic Union. This outcome underscores growing voter dissatisfaction concerning economic challenges and migration policies. Many voters were also swayed by their opposition to Berlin's stance on Ukraine. Mainstream political parties continue to shut the AfD out of any potential governing alliances.
item.dc:creator: ARYAN SINGH

item.title: Iran rules out reopening Strait of Hormuz, returning to US talks until conditions met
item.description: Iran remains steadfast in its decision to keep the Strait of Hormuz closed and discontinue negotiations until its stipulations are satisfied. Tehran has communicated its demands to Washington via third parties, now awaiting a response. The nation has issued a warning regarding potential attacks on US bases should military action ensue, while US forces have redirected commercial vessels amidst a naval blockade.
item.dc:creator: ARYAN SINGH

item.title: Olympiad: Pragg outwits Dutch No. 1 Anish Giri for first win; sister Vaishali loses
item.description: At the 2026 Chess Olympiad, R Praggnanandhaa secured his first win by outplaying Dutch No. 1 Anish Giri in a tense Ruy Lopez, helping India beat the Netherlands 3-1. Gukesh also won, while Erigaisi and Nihal drew. India’s women suffered a narrow 1.5-2.5 loss to Poland, with Vaishali defeated by Aleksandra Maltsevskaya. Poland have now beaten India in three successive Olympiads.
item.dc:creator: JYOTIRMOY HALDER

item.title: Cindy Crawford's son Presley Gerber passes away at 27
item.description: Presley Gerber, son of Cindy Crawford, has died at age twenty-seven. He passed away on Sunday, September twentieth, at a rehabilitation facility. Presley Gerber had openly discussed his struggles with mental health and substance abuse. He actively advocated for mental health awareness to assist others. The family is requesting privacy during this difficult period.

item.title: Iran threatens 'painful retaliation' if US strikes as Trump warns of 'big things'
item.description: Iran has reiterated its commitment to retaliate against the United States and its allies for any major offensive, citing credible intelligence indicating such actions are imminent. In response, President Donald Trump has issued a stern warning to Tehran about potential severe repercussions. The recent violence, including attacks by Yemen's Iran-backed Houthis on Saudi sites, has aggravated tensions and disrupted regional energy supplies and maritime operations.

item.title: 'New Found Glory' band guitarist Chad Gilbert passes away at 45
item.description: Chad Gilbert, New Found Glory's lead guitarist, has died at age 45. He passed away peacefully in his sleep surrounded by loved ones. Gilbert battled serious health challenges including brain tumors and cancer. His guitar playing and songwriting significantly shaped the band's sound. He is remembered as a legendary musician and devoted family man.
item.dc:creator: etimes.in

item.title: Aamir Khan’s Arjuna-winning ‘coach’ fights to save Indore akhada
item.description: Young wrestlers at Indore's Malhar Ashram train amidst severe infrastructure decay. Leaking roofs and damaged walls force them to bail out rainwater regularly. The center lacks basic facilities like changing rooms and functional toilets for all. Arjuna awardee Kripa Shankar Bishnoi mentors these aspiring champions without adequate resources. He has raised concerns with the chief minister regarding the deteriorating conditions.
item.dc:creator: LITHA ACHARI

item.title: Russia wraps up first wartime parliamentary election, Kremlin set to retain control
item.description: Russia's parliamentary elections concluded on Sunday, projecting that the United Russia party will continue to rule. This election was marred by a heavy clampdown on opposition and dissent, alongside controversial voting in Ukrainian territories annexed by Russia. Ukraine condemned these actions, leading to international outcry, as numerous watchdogs deemed the election illegal under global treaties. Results are anticipated soon after the conclusion of voting in western Russia.
item.dc:creator: TRISHA MAHAJAN

item.title: 5th case slapped on Congress’ Nandigram nominee Milan Pradhan, party to move HC
item.description: The Congress party's candidate in Nandigram, Milan Pradhan, is under scrutiny with five pending cases, including two recent filings. He will remain in judicial custody until October 3 due to murder allegations, following the issuance of arrest warrants against him in separate instances. To assist Pradhan, the Congress plans to file for bail in the Calcutta High Court, as his legal troubles cast a shadow over their campaign strategy.
item.dc:creator: SUMAN MANDAL

item.title: Rajasthan stakes claim to erstwhile Jaipur state properties across 4 UP cities
item.description: Rajasthan has claimed ownership of former Jaipur princely state properties in four UP districts. UP authorities are now reviewing revenue and ownership records dating back over seventy years. This claim has prompted a detailed examination of old sale deeds and present possession. In Agra, the claim covers significant land, including Jaipur House and temple properties. Transactions in Prayagraj have been temporarily halted pending verification of historical ownership entries.
item.dc:creator: SUDEEP LAVANIA

item.title: 'Could change a lot': Zelenskky and Trump to meet in New York ahead of UNGA
item.description: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy and US President Trump have agreed to a crucial meeting in New York, coinciding with the UN General Assembly. Zelenskyy thanked the US special envoys for their recent visit to Kyiv. During their discussion, the leaders emphasized the importance of security issues and outlined steps towards de-escalation, signaling a collaborative approach towards a stable future for Ukraine.

item.title: Trump adds drones, snipers and ammunition to plans for Washington triumphal arch
item.description: US President Trump announced plans to transform a proposed triumphal arch into a military complex. This new facility will house and deploy drones and snipers for national security. The structure is planned near Arlington Memorial Bridge, adjacent to the cemetery. Veterans have filed lawsuits challenging the arch's construction and sightline disruption. The Federal Aviation Administration has cleared aviation concerns for the proposed arch.
